name: Email Octopus
description: Connects Drupal to the EmailOctopus API to place newsletter subscribe blocks and manage list subscribers.
project_description:
Contains the Email Octopus API Integration for subscriber requests. 
 The key feature of this module is that you can place multiple blocks while selecting a different list. 
 It provides the dashboard within drupal to check the subscribers/unsubscribers 
 You can customize its body, thankyou message etc 
 This module is safe to use on a production site. 
 
 INSTALLATION 
 

composer require 'drupal/email_octopus'

drush en email_octopus

 

 CONFIGURATION 
 
 `Admin -> Extend` & enable the module. 
 `Admin -> System -> Email Octopus Settings`. 
 Add an API key, it is required for successful integration. 
 Click on the "`Subscriber / Unsubscriber List`" tab to check for lists and users. 
 `Admin -> Structure -> Block layout -> Place block`. With the required fields. 
 
 Required list 
 Block title 
 Block body 
 Thank you Message 
 
 Back to top
